reason_for_amendment.official_mexc_documentation: MEXC Spot historical market-data documentation states downloadable Spot kline/trading data are available since 01-01-2023.
reason_for_amendment.observed_bulk_availability: For every frozen symbol, the first visible official MEXC 15m monthly bulk file is the 2023-02 partition.
reason_for_amendment.rule: The boundary is amended prospectively because the originally frozen 2022 source window cannot be supplied by the authorized official MEXC bulk source and no alternate exchange may be used.

effective_discovery_window.rationale_start: The MEXC 2023-02 provider partition starts at 2023-01-31T16:00:00Z because provider month labels use UTC+08:00. The first 32 fifteen-minute candles are outside the amended UTC Discovery window and MUST be excluded before P00 evaluation.
effective_discovery_window.rationale_end: The MEXC 2024-12 provider partition ends at 2024-12-31T16:00:00Z. The remaining 8 UTC hours of calendar 2024 belong to provider partition 2025-01. Reading that partition before Discovery SURVIVES would violate the physical 2025 validation lock, so those hours are prospectively excluded.

final_rule: After this amendment and a green six-symbol preflight, one offline P00_PRIMARY Discovery outcome run is authorized over the exact effective UTC window above. The run may classify Discovery only. It may not read 2025/2026, submit orders, mutate an exchange, authorize live trading, merge to main, or deploy to Render.
